verdict.rationale: Mailgun's first-party docs have a dedicated SDK section stating it offers a variety of official SDKs across multiple programming languages for sending, receiving, and tracking email, which covers the core of building against official SDKs. The evidence is limited to that introductory page. Missing for 10: no named supported languages, installation or usage docs, maturity or maintenance details, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
